TABLE 8.2 Types of Diabetes, the Involved Metabolic Processes, and Possible Treatments 
Any of the subcategories of diabetes lead to the same clinical objective finding of hyperglycemia, which is defined as 
a fasting serum glucose level greater than 126 mg/dL, a random glucose level greater than 200 mg/dL, or a 
hemoglobin A1C (HbA1c) greater than 6.5% (Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality, n.d.; Sapra & Bhandari, 
2023). Many health care providers check clients’ HbA1c levels when monitoring blood glucose control and dietary 
modifications. Continuously elevated levels impair the beta-cell function of the pancreas, resulting in further

secretion of insulin (Sapra & Bhandari, 2023). This destruction of insulin-producing cells, usually secondary to an
